findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "gather_quick_read" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: audience, options, question, context, audience_type, respondents

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gather_quick_read, gather_list_studies, gather_list_content, gather_create_content, gather_run_simulation, gather_what_to_publish, gather_report_start, gather_test_creatives · Private data: gather_research_answer, gather_export_responses, gather_test_creatives · Public sink: gather_quick_read, gather_research_answer, gather_find_stats, gather_create_content, gather_design_study, gather_this_week, gather_what_to_publish, gather_draft_article, gather_test_creatives · Destructive: gather_run_simulation, gather_this_week, gather_test_creatives.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gather_quick_read, gather_list_studies, gather_list_content, gather_create_content, gather_run_simulation, gather_what_to_publish, gather_report_start, gather_test_creatives · Private data: gather_research_answer, gather_export_responses, gather_test_creatives · Public sink: gather_quick_read, gather_research_answer, gather_find_stats, gather_create_content, gather_design_study, gather_this_week, gather_what_to_publish, gather_draft_article, gather_test_creatives · Destructive: gather_run_simulation, gather_this_week, gather_test_creatives

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
